answer: In PoA, every identity escrows collateral, so splitting stake across accounts does not avoid accountability. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting messages, correlated evidence aggregates exposure into a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), rather than k independent fines. The juniper monitor emits a shared signal; a hollow account can therefore link the swarm. Upon detection, asymmetric depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making sybil control economically prohibitive.
